environment: Local Node 24, real ZIP writer/reader and production service code with synthetic Firestore and object storage
observed: The preview returned the cross-period title and coverage without private body text. Its manual inclusion produced the exact current body and a named inventory in summary.md. The deselected document was absent from the manifest exceptions and inventory; the dated task remained.
The importer rejected misbound snapshots, extra exception history and missing pinned content, including content that became unreadable after its head was read.
The selected out-of-period general file kept its name and bytes. The excluded recording, bytes and transcript were absent in dated and all-time exports.
The authenticated preview endpoint returned an empty avatar page with version zero. Creating from a stale workspace or avatar version was rejected. Existing operation recovery remained usable.
failuresRetained: Before implementation the pipeline had no preview entry and the dated worker ignored explicit pins.
Review identified a full-period explicit inclusion that could outlive a readable report body. The worker now verifies both the version and the readable body before publishing.
